notes.title: Demo Hotfix 2
notes.content:
Hello,

we've uploaded an update which fixes a rare crash during the battles. We've also balanced some attacking waves. Getting to the final wave is now easier.

notes.title: Hotfix for demo
notes.content:
Hello!

We've uploaded a small hotfix which fixes an error while loading the game. You should now no longer be stuck on the "loading military" screen.

notes.title: Demo Update for Steam Next
notes.content:
Hello there!

We've updated our demo for the Steam Next Festival, fixing some errors and improving several aspects:

[list]
[*]  Fixed a bug with the market which prohibited players from buying goods
[*]  Fixed a bug that sometimes broke soldier formations too early 
[*]  Improved some graphics
[*]  Mage fireballs look like actual fireballs now. With sound! 
[*]  Improved some events
[*]  Made the game slightly easier. It's still quite challenging. 
[*]  Implemented the missing buildings
[*]  You can now win the game! Just build a temple. Easy!
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello friends. 

We are alive and still working on Altwaldheim 2. The demo is out, but there are some things we want to improve. Today, we have a small update for you, fixing several issues: 

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash when having large armies
[*] Fixed missing sprites for some units (they appeared as white squares during battles)
[*] Fixed some missing texts in both the German and English versions
[*] Fixed some typos. 
[*] Changed the trading system. There is no longer a limited amount of transactions. The system was too janky. When you upgrade your marketplace, the ordering time will reduce from 4 weeks to 3 weeks  
[/list]
[b]
Known issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Trolls love changing their skin. Not intended though. 
[*] The game is not intended for battles with more than 10k units. It will look weird and ugly if you manage to recruit that many soldiers. 
[*] The sound and music options are not saved between games,
[/list]
[b]
Plans for future updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Implement the embassy and temple. They have no functions at the moment
[*] Balancing
[*] Add more enemy waves for longer gameplay
[*] Add more sounds in the battles, e.g. units dying
[*] Add more events
[*] Add options to increase battle speed
[/list]

That's it for today. Feel free to contact us any times in the steam forum or in discord: https://discord.gg/g4R8D6e  

Have a nice day!
[i]Ludlus[/i]
